The '''Krykis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Duluur sector/Legends|Duluur sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krykis IV]].
